'''Brzo's Wells''' was an area with wells within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]] around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Brzo's Wells" /> Around that time, an individual affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], came to Brzo's Wells seeking to disrupt the [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]] in the space station. The individual was ambushed by [[the Brothers]] but managed to defeat the [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]].<ref name="Breaking the Yoke">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=heroic|Breaking the Yoke|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Brzo's Well was created for the [[2019]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]] Digital Expansion for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
